Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the…
Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

people.name: Philip
people.line: One of the seven deacons, evangelized in Samaria

translations.web: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”
translations.bsb: “Tell me,” said the eunuch, “who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?”
translations.kjv: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?
translations.asv: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other?
